🗳️ Weekly Poll 📊

Loading...💬Introduction for Today🎯

The A.I. hype bubble in the stock market appears to have popped (don’t tell that to Nvidia’s stock). August seasonally is not a great month for the stock market. However more adoption and startups in Generative A.I. fights against the current of a V.C. slowdown and a mini-apocalypse startup period. 

This wasn’t an overly eventful week in A.I. Let’s briefly check out some of the top news. Still, I think we can throw some news together. 

📢Top News 📺

AI language models are ​rife with different political biases​ (MIT Tech Review)

Microsoft offers "Private ChatGPT" as a free Azure app

Spotify: expands its ​AI-powered DJ feature globally​ (for now only in English)

Researchers develop AI that can log keystrokes ​acoustically with 92-95 percent accuracy​

Stability AI ​announces StableCode​ (Official)

Anthropic: launches ​improved version of its entry-level LLM​

ChatGPT expands its​ ‘custom instructions’ feature to free users​

Microsoft's Bing: ​AI powered Bing is now six months old​, but does anyone care?
